verdict.rationale: Green and Spiegel is an immigration law firm offering legal consultation and visa services, not a software platform. Versioned APIs with a deprecation policy are a category error for this kind of product. Probes also found no OpenAPI spec or llms.txt, so nothing shows the firm ships an API that would make the axis apply.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
